extraFacts.fact: Hose dash sizes count sixteenths of an inch of hose bore: -3 is 3/16 inch, -4 is 1/4 inch, -5 is 5/16 inch, -6 is 3/8 inch, -8 is 1/2 inch, -10 is 5/8 inch, -12 is 3/4 inch and -16 is 1 inch.
extraFacts.source: SAE J517 / SAE J514 dash size convention; the Parker 56 Series size tables on this site

extraFacts.fact: SAE J517 gives the general, dimensional and performance specifications for the SAE 100R series of hydraulic hose, including 100R7 (single-fibre-braid thermoplastic) and 100R8 (double-fibre-braid thermoplastic).

faqs.q: What is SAE 100R18 non-conductive orange thermoplastic hose used for?
faqs.a: The SAE 100R18 non-conductive orange hose is a thermoplastic hydraulic hose with a polyester elastomer tube and a low-friction non-conductive polyester cover, for equipment that works near high voltage. The listing names aerial platforms, cranes and rescue tools.

faqs.q: How do I read the part number IH-HS-R18LFNC-04 for the SAE 100R18 Non-Conductive Thermoplastic Hydraulic Hose, Orange?
faqs.a: In IH-HS-R18LFNC-04 the prefix IH-HS-R18LFNC is the non-conductive low-friction R18 hose and the last number is the bore as a dash size in sixteenths of an inch: 04 is 1/4 inch, 05 is 5/16 inch, 06 is 3/8 inch and 08 is 1/2 inch. The rows give each as a per-foot supply.

faqs.q: Which sizes does the SAE 100R18 Non-Conductive Thermoplastic Hydraulic Hose, Orange come in?
faqs.a: Four sizes are listed: IH-HS-R18LFNC-04 (1/4 inch), -05 (5/16 inch), -06 (3/8 inch) and -08 (1/2 inch), each supplied per foot. The Sizes & Part Numbers table lists them, and other sizes are quoted on request.

faqs.q: How do I choose the size of the SAE 100R18 Non-Conductive Thermoplastic Hydraulic Hose, Orange?
faqs.a: Choose the bore from the flow the tool or boom needs: the four sizes run from 1/4 inch to 1/2 inch, and the pressure is the same at each. Remember the end fittings, and the electrical test of the finished assembly, which matter as much as the hose.

faqs.q: What working pressure does the SAE 100R18 Non-Conductive Thermoplastic Hydraulic Hose, Orange have?
faqs.a: SAE J517 100R18 sets a working pressure of 3,000 psi for every size from 3/16 inch to 1 inch, and the manufacturer publishes no separate figure. Non-conductive service also needs the assembly tested for electrical leakage to the standard your equipment follows.

faqs.q: What is the SAE 100R18 Non-Conductive Thermoplastic Hydraulic Hose, Orange made from, and what is its temperature range?
faqs.a: The tube is polyester elastomer, reinforced with one or two synthetic-fibre braids, and the cover is low-friction orange polyester that is non-conductive. The temperature range is −67 °F to 212 °F (−55 °C to 100 °C), as published.

faqs.q: Which standard does the SAE 100R18 Non-Conductive Thermoplastic Hydraulic Hose, Orange meet?
faqs.a: The hose is made to SAE J517 100R18, which sets 3,000 psi working pressure in every size. The listing does not state an electrical rating, so ask us for the leakage-test standard your equipment follows before ordering.

faqs.q: Which fittings suit the SAE 100R18 Non-Conductive Thermoplastic Hydraulic Hose, Orange?
faqs.a: Use fittings made for thermoplastic hose and crimp them to the maker's specification for 100R18. The [thermoplastic hose fittings guide](/blog/thermoplastic-hose-fittings-guide) explains the match; the [thermoplastic hoses shelf](/c/thermoplastic-hoses) lists related thermoplastic hoses.

faqs.q: How do I route and fit the SAE 100R18 Non-Conductive Thermoplastic Hydraulic Hose, Orange?
faqs.a: Route the hose with the bend radius and without twist, and keep it clean and dry at the ends. After assembly, have the finished hose tested for electrical leakage to the standard your equipment follows; the [hose routing, bend radius and twist guide](/blog/hose-routing-bend-radius-twist) covers routing.

faqs.q: What is the difference between the non-conductive orange R18 hose and the black low-friction R18 hose?
faqs.a: The orange hose is non-conductive and listed in 4 sizes from 1/4 inch to 1/2 inch, whereas the [SAE 100R18 Thermoplastic Hydraulic Hose, Low-Friction Black Cover](/p/sae-100r18-thermoplastic-hydraulic-hose-low-friction-black-cover) has a black cover and is listed in 6 sizes from 3/16 inch to 5/8 inch. Choose the orange hose near high voltage and the black one for forklifts and cold-working machines.
